authorship_scope.basis: Project-owner instruction supplied the author identity and authorized attribution; first-add Git author metadata for the selected files is consistent with the named author/account aliases.
authorship_scope.limit: Git metadata is contribution evidence, not independent proof of legal title. Files with other contributors, existing bylines/notices, generated material, research/contest status, or unresolved contact/data flags were preserved.

license_scope.linked_file_scope: Different repository; does not establish this repository's license.

citation_scope.reason: The README says to cite the research work rather than the server; its existing paper citation was preserved unchanged.

official_contest_sources.finding: The official Book Ramsey Numbers page lists the problem as unsolved and specifies a Python solution function/output format, source-code placement restriction and runtime limit. Epoch states its problem materials may be reused under CC BY with attribution. This does not establish local submission status or authorship; Ramsey-named files were preserved.

The official page currently labels the order-668 problem solved by human + AI and says the attribution is provisional, crediting three humans and Claude. This does not establish local file authorship or submission status; Hadamard-named materials were preserved.

The official FAQ directs solvers to follow the problem-page output format for verification. It does not grant a license to local solutions or establish their authorship; relevant local files were preserved.

security_review.email_phone_regex_matches: Present in historical/current tree; not validated as contacts; values omitted, ambiguous files preserved.
